text: I've been waiting ages for someone to ring me back. My daughter is 16 months and she just had a fit. Never happened before. She went stiff then started shaking all over and her eyes rolled back. Temp is 38.6. She's been teething all week, drooling, chewing everything and her cheek's bright red, so I thought that's all it was. I need someone to tell me what to do NOW.
